create_custom_distribution: create a custom distribution by subclassing Distribution and implementing _sample_n, log_prob, and event_shape
sample_from_distribution: sample from a distribution using the sample method with a seed and sample_shape argument
convert_seed_and_sample_shape: convert a seed and sample_shape into a normalized PRNGKey and tuple shape using convert_seed_and_sample_shape
index_batch_shape: convert an index into batch shape indices using to_batch_shape_index for a given batch_shape
test_distribution_jittable: test that a distribution sampling function is compatible with jax.jit compilation
